about: Defence moves (3.3 batch, lane A; SIG-DEFENCE 2026-11-20): the species whose own stored text says they curl into a ball, withdraw into a shell, puff up, drop the tail, flash hidden wing colour, rear up, shake to a blur, thump or stamp, flag a white tail, contract flat, pull in their legs, puff a beard or lock out fin spines when a predator is near (or, a stamp, at a disturbance), with the row's sentence for the live log. Built by scripts/ark-defence-moves.mts from AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json; never edited by hand.

species.name: African Pygmy Hedgehog
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling up to protect its softest parts
species.behaviour: curls into a spiny ball
species.quote: Curling behavior protects the softest parts first

species.name: Algerian Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is rolling into a flat spiral after a disturbance
species.behaviour: rolls into a flat spiral when disturbed
species.quote: Rolls into a flat spiral when disturbed

species.name: Amazon Sailfin Catfish
species.line: {aAnimal} is locking its fin spines out against a predator
species.behaviour: locks its fin spines out against predators
species.quote: Their answer is armour plating and locking fin spines that make a small mouth impossible.

species.name: American Giant Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is coiling into a tight spiral and lying still
species.behaviour: coils into a tight spiral and lies still
species.quote: Its first response is to coil into a tight spiral that shields the legs and soft underside, lying still until the danger passes.

species.name: Asian Forest Tortoise
species.line: {aAnimal} is drawing back into its shell
species.behaviour: withdraws into shell
species.quote: It withdraws into its shell when disturbed.

species.name: Asian Tramp Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling back into its shell at a touch
species.behaviour: pulls back into shell when touched
species.quote: It pulls back into the shell when touched.

species.name: Ball Python
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling into a tight ball with its head tucked inside the coils
species.behaviour: curls into a tight ball with head tucked when threatened
species.quote: When threatened or stressed, Ball Pythons curl into a tight, compact ball, tucking their head safely within the coils.

species.name: Black-and-yellow Garden Spider
species.line: {aAnimal} is pumping its web back and forth until its outline blurs
species.behaviour: pumps web back and forth until outline blurs
species.quote: A threatened spider pumps its web back and forth until its outline blurs, or drops to the ground and hides among the plants.

species.name: Bold Jumper
species.line: {aAnimal} is cornered, raising its front legs and showing its metallic jaws
species.behaviour: cornered: raises front legs, shows metallic jaws
species.quote: Cornered spiders raise the front legs and show the metallic jaws.

species.name: Bronze Corydoras
species.line: {aAnimal} is locking its sharp fin spines upright
species.behaviour: locks fin spines upright to be hard to swallow
species.quote: stiff, sharp spines on the dorsal and pectoral fins, which it can lock upright to make itself hard to swallow

species.name: Brown Widow Spider
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling up defensively after a disturbance
species.behaviour: retreats or curls up when disturbed
species.quote: When disturbed, Brown Widows commonly retreat or curl defensively rather than pursuing an attacker.

species.name: Carolina Wolf Spider
species.line: {aAnimal} is cornered, rearing up to show its fangs
species.behaviour: sprints into burrow; cornered rears up showing fangs
species.quote: It escapes by sprinting into its burrow; cornered, it rears up to show its fangs and may bite.

species.name: Central Bearded Dragon
species.line: {aAnimal} is puffing out and darkening its beard
species.behaviour: beard puff and darken in threat/display
species.quote: Beard display: the throat can darken and expand during threat or social signaling.

species.name: Chaco Golden Knee Tarantula
species.line: {aAnimal} is holding a threat posture, long before any strike
species.behaviour: holds threat posture long before striking
species.quote: a threat posture held long before any strike

species.name: Common Carpet Beetle
species.line: {aAnimal} has pulled in its legs and antennae and is playing dead
species.behaviour: pulls in legs and antennae and lies still, feigning death
species.quote: When disturbed, adults often pull in their legs and antennae and lie still, feigning death.

species.name: Common House Gecko
species.line: {aAnimal} is escaping while its shed tail keeps twitching
species.behaviour: sheds tail that keeps twitching while it escapes
species.quote: A seized gecko sheds its tail, which keeps twitching while the animal escapes

species.name: Common House Spider
species.line: {aAnimal} has pulled in its legs and is hanging motionless
species.behaviour: drops on thread or pulls legs in and hangs motionless
species.quote: A disturbed spider drops on a thread or pulls in its legs and hangs motionless.

species.name: Daddy Long-Legs Spider
species.line: {aAnimal} is whirling its body so fast that it becomes a blur
species.behaviour: whirls body in web until it is a blur
species.quote: When disturbed or threatened, it whirls its body so fast that it becomes a blur, making it difficult for an attacker to strike or even see.

species.name: Danube River Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling into its shell and shutting the opening with its hard lid
species.behaviour: pulls into shell and shuts it with a hard lid
species.quote: Threatened, the snail pulls its body into the shell and shuts the opening with its hard lid.

species.name: Domestic Rabbit
species.line: {aAnimal} is thumping a hind foot on the ground to warn the others
species.behaviour: freezes, bolts zigzag, thumps a warning
species.quote: A rabbit freezes first, then bolts in a zigzag for cover, and thumps a hind foot on the ground to warn others.

species.name: Eastern Box Turtle
species.line: {aAnimal} is closed up tight inside its shell
species.behaviour: closes up fully inside hinged shell
species.quote: A closed-up adult resists most attacks

species.name: Eastern Cottontail
species.line: {aAnimal} is zigzagging away, flashing its white tail
species.behaviour: freezes, then sprints in sharp zigzags flashing white tail
species.quote: During escape, the Eastern Cottontail's prominent white tail (scut) is often flashed, drawing attention as it zigs and zags.

species.name: European Hedgehog
species.line: {aAnimal} is rolling into a spiny ball at a threat
species.behaviour: rolls into a spiny ball when threatened
species.quote: European Hedgehogs roll into a spiny ball when strongly threatened.

species.name: European Pond Terrapin
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling its head and limbs inside its hard shell
species.behaviour: withdraws head and limbs into shell
species.quote: can pull the head and limbs inside the hard shell

species.name: European Rabbit
species.line: {aAnimal} is thumping its hind feet and dashing for the burrow, white tail flashing
species.behaviour: thumps then dashes for burrow flashing white tail
species.quote: On sensing danger, a feeding rabbit thumps the ground with its hind feet and dashes for the burrow, flashing the white underside of its tail.

species.name: Flamed Tigersnail
species.line: {aAnimal} is withdrawing into its shell
species.behaviour: withdraws into shell, shelters in litter by day
species.quote: It withdraws into its shell and shelters in damp leaf litter, logs and crevices by day.

species.name: Fowler's Toad
species.line: {aAnimal} is puffing up and flattening itself at a threat
species.behaviour: puffs up or flattens when threatened
species.quote: a threatened toad may puff up, flatten or play dead

species.name: Giant African Land Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling deep into its shell after a disturbance
species.behaviour: pulls deep into shell when disturbed
species.quote: A disturbed snail pulls deep into its shell.

species.name: Giant African Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is coiling its body into a tight spiral at a threat
species.behaviour: coils into a tight spiral when threatened
species.quote: When threatened, the Giant African Millipede typically coils its body into a tight spiral, protecting its vulnerable underside and presenting its harder exoskeleton.

species.name: Giant Forest Scorpion
species.line: {aAnimal} is holding a defensive posture
species.behaviour: defensive posture before stinging
species.quote: Defensive posture before stinging

species.name: Giant Golden Orb-weaver
species.line: {aAnimal} is shaking its web violently after a disturbance
species.behaviour: shakes web violently or drops from hub on a line
species.quote: Disturbed, the spider may shake the web violently or drop from the hub on a line.

species.name: Giant Whip Scorpion
species.line: {aAnimal} is rearing up and holding its heavy pincers open towards an attacker
species.behaviour: rears up holding heavy pincers open
species.quote: Faced with a threat, it rears up and holds its heavy pincers open towards the attacker.

species.name: Great Plains Toad
species.line: {aAnimal} is puffing itself up with air at a threat
species.behaviour: puffs up with air when threatened
species.quote: a threatened toad puffs up with air

species.name: Greek Tortoise
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulled into its shell with scaly forelimbs closing the front
species.behaviour: pulls into shell and closes front with scaly forelimbs
species.quote: Nosed by a fox or dog, it pulls head, legs and tail into the shell, closes the front with its scaly forelimbs and stays put.

species.name: Green-blotched Moth
species.line: {aAnimal} is opening its leaf-like green forewings to reveal orange hindwings
species.behaviour: opens its leaf-like forewings to flash orange hindwings when disturbed
species.quote: At rest the green forewings resemble a leaf; if disturbed it opens them to reveal the orange hindwings, which may startle an attacker.

species.name: Grovesnail
species.line: {aAnimal} is rapidly pulling its soft body back into its hard shell
species.behaviour: retracts instantly at a bird's shadow or touch
species.quote: Upon sensing a threat, such as a bird's shadow, a sudden vibration, or a direct touch, the Grovesnail rapidly retracts its soft body into the safety of its hard, calcified shell.

species.name: Harnessed Moth
species.line: {aAnimal} is flashing the scarlet hindwings it kept hidden underneath
species.behaviour: sits camouflaged, then flashes scarlet hindwings when touched
species.quote: The Harnessed Moth sits camouflaged until it is touched, then flashes scarlet hindwings kept hidden underneath.

species.name: Leaf-eating Slug
species.line: {aAnimal} is contracting into a stiff, flat shape and coating itself in sticky mucus
species.behaviour: contracts into a stiff flattened shape coated in mucus when touched
species.quote: When touched it contracts into a stiff, flattened shape and coats itself in sticky mucus.

species.name: Long-spined Porcupinefish
species.line: {aAnimal} is puffing up like a balloon, sharp spines standing out
species.behaviour: puffs up like a balloon with spines standing out
species.quote: The Long-spined Porcupinefish can puff up its body like a balloon and show off its sharp spines to scare away predators.

species.name: Malayan Box Turtle
species.line: {aAnimal} is clamping its lower shell shut, sealed into a hard box
species.behaviour: seals itself into a hinged box
species.quote: Grabbed or threatened, it pulls head, legs and tail inside and clamps its lower shell tight against the upper one, sealing itself into a hard box with no gap to bite into.

species.name: Malaysian Forest Scorpion
species.line: {aAnimal} is raising its broad pincers and arching its tail over its back
species.behaviour: raises broad pincers and arches tail over back near burrow
species.quote: When threatened near its burrow, it raises its broad pincers, arches its tail over its back and can make a faint hissing rasp by rubbing parts of its body together.

species.name: Mediterranean Hermit Crab
species.line: {aAnimal} is deep in its shell, blocking the opening with its large right claw
species.behaviour: withdraws and blocks opening with large right claw
species.quote: It withdraws deep into its shell and blocks the opening with its large right claw

species.name: Pill Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling up tightly at a touch and staying closed
species.behaviour: rolls into a tight ball within a second and stays closed
species.quote: Touched on a woodland floor, it curls up within a second and stays tightly closed until the disturbance has passed.

species.name: Pointed Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is withdrawing into its shell after a disturbance
species.behaviour: withdraws into its shell when disturbed
species.quote: When disturbed it withdraws into its shell.

species.name: Rainbow Crab
species.line: {aAnimal} is turning to face an attacker with its claws raised and spread
species.behaviour: bolts for burrow or faces attacker with claws raised and spread
species.quote: When threatened it bolts for its burrow or turns to face the attacker with claws raised and spread.

species.name: Red-necked Wallaby
species.line: {aAnimal} is thumping the ground with its hind feet and bounding into cover
species.behaviour: thumps ground with hind feet then bounds into cover
species.quote: When alarmed it thumps the ground with its hind feet and bounds into cover.

species.name: Red Tegu
species.line: {aAnimal} is cornered, hissing and puffing itself up
species.behaviour: cornered: hisses, puffs up, tail lash
species.quote: A threatened tegu runs for its burrow, and if cornered it hisses, puffs up and bites.

species.name: Redclaw Crayfish
species.line: {aAnimal} is cornered, rearing up with its claws raised and open
species.behaviour: cornered: rears up with claws raised and open
species.quote: Cornered, it rears up with claws raised and open.

species.name: Reeves' Turtle
species.line: {aAnimal} is withdrawing into its shell
species.behaviour: withdraws into shell
species.quote: Adults withdraw into the shell

species.name: Rugose Hermit Crab
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling back into its shell and blocking the opening with a claw
species.behaviour: pulls into shell and blocks with claw, or lets go and drops
species.quote: Its answer to a threat is to pull back into the shell and block the opening with a claw, or to let go of its foothold and drop.

species.name: Savannah Monitor
species.line: {aAnimal} is cornered, hissing, puffing up and lashing its tail
species.behaviour: cornered: hisses, puffs up, lashes tail
species.quote: A cornered lizard hisses, puffs up its body, lashes its tail and bites.

species.name: Scarlet Tiger Moth
species.line: {aAnimal} is opening its dark wings to show the bright red ones underneath
species.behaviour: opens its dark wings to show bright red ones when bothered
species.quote: When something bothers it, the Scarlet Tiger Moth opens its dark wings and shows bright red ones underneath.

species.name: Shore Crab
species.line: {aAnimal} is facing an attacker with its claws raised
species.behaviour: faces attacker with claws raised; hides or buries in sand
species.quote: It hides under weed and stones or buries itself in sand, and faces an attacker with claws raised.

species.name: Short-beaked Echidna
species.line: {aAnimal} is digging in and curling up
species.behaviour: digs in and curls up against predators
species.quote: Digging in and curling make defense portable.

species.name: Silver Argiope
species.line: {aAnimal} is whipping its whole orb back and forth until its outline blurs
species.behaviour: whips the whole orb until its outline blurs, then drops
species.quote: Threatened, the spider whips the entire orb back and forth until its own outline blurs, then drops on a line if that fails.

species.name: Southern Tamandua
species.line: {aAnimal} is standing upright with its claws out at a threat
species.behaviour: rears upright with claws out when threatened
species.quote: Defensive upright posture using claws when threatened

species.name: Southern Toad
species.line: {aAnimal} is puffing its body up with air at a threat
species.behaviour: puffs up its body with air when threatened
species.quote: A threatened toad puffs up its body with air, making it harder to swallow.

species.name: Stars and Stripes Pufferfish
species.line: {aAnimal} is gulping water and swelling into a stiff, prickly ball
species.behaviour: gulps water to swell into a stiff prickly ball when grabbed
species.quote: When grabbed or cornered, it gulps water into an elastic stomach until its body swells into a stiff, prickly ball far too wide for most mouths.

species.name: Sunda Pangolin
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling up tight against a threat
species.behaviour: rolls up into a scaly ball
species.quote: Curling works against many predators

species.name: Trashline Orb-weaver
species.line: {aAnimal} is shaking its web so that its outline blurs
species.behaviour: shakes web to blur or drops and lies still
species.quote: A disturbed spider may shake the web so that its outline blurs, or drop to the ground on a safety line and lie still.

species.name: Tropical Leatherleaf Slug
species.line: {aAnimal} is contracting into a firm oval and drawing its tentacles under its mantle
species.behaviour: contracts into a firm oval, tucks tentacles under mantle
species.quote: A touched slug contracts into a firm oval, draws its tentacles under the mantle and gives off sticky mucus.

species.name: Walking Catfish
species.line: {aAnimal} is locking its pectoral spines erect
species.behaviour: locks its pectoral spines erect
species.quote: Its pectoral spines can be locked erect, making it awkward to swallow.

species.name: White-tailed Deer
species.line: {aAnimal} is snorting loudly and stamping a forefoot at danger it cannot see
species.behaviour: snorts and stamps a forefoot at unseen danger
species.quote: A deer that senses danger it cannot yet see often snorts loudly and stamps a forefoot.

species.name: Woodlouse Hunter Spider
species.line: {aAnimal} is rearing up and spreading its jaws at a threat
species.behaviour: rears up and spreads jaws when threatened
species.quote: When threatened it rears up, spreads its jaws and bites readily.
